items.t: The Crest condos and townhomes for sale

blocks.text: The Crest homes listed and sold, June to September 2026

The Crest, September 2026. Detached houses: 14 listed at month end and 2 sold in September, a sales ratio of 14% (a balanced market). Condos and townhomes: 6 listed at month end and 2 sold in September, a sales ratio of 33%.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, Detached houses: 7 sold over 4 months against an average of 14.5 listed, about 8.3 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was August with 3 sold. Condos and townhomes: 4 sold over 4 months against an average of 7.0 listed, about 7.0 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was September with 2 sold.

faq.q: Where is The Crest in Burnaby?
faq.a: In south-east Burnaby on the Edmonds / East Burnaby side, around 10th Avenue, 6th Street and Edmonds Street near the New Westminster border; "The Crest" is the GVR MLS® sub-area name and matches the local Crest Centre plaza (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats GVR September 2026 report).

faq.q: What sold in The Crest in September 2026?
faq.a: Detached: 2 solds from 14 listings (14% sales ratio); condos & townhomes: 2 solds from 6 listings (33%) — both are very small samples. Burnaby-wide, the median detached sale price was $1,825,000 and the condos & townhomes median was $686,000 that month (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats GVR September 2026 report).

faq.q: Which schools are in or near The Crest?
faq.a: Second Street Community Elementary (K–7), 7502 2nd St, and Morley Elementary (K–7), 7355 Morley St, with Byrne Creek Community Secondary (8–12), 7777 18th St, the nearest secondary on the Province's SD41 list; catchments are address-based, so check the exact address in the SD41 locator.

faq.q: Is there a SkyTrain station in The Crest?
faq.a: No — Edmonds Station on the Expo Line, west of the sub-area, is the SkyTrain link for this area.
